summary: A year after the National Guard deployment to Washington, D.C., the city continues to grapple with federal control and restrictions on local autonomy. The Department of Justice has opposed the D.C. Council's efforts to withdraw National Guard troops, while advocacy groups including DC Vote and ACLU DC are using the anniversary to highlight how the incident demonstrates the need for statehood. Additionally, DC Vote is pushing back against what it characterizes as a federal attack on the city's fiscal independence.
